t: From Rabbit Holes to Roadmaps: Using LLMs for SEO Software Dev
s: This article chronicles using multiple LLM assistants (Gemini, Grok, ChatGPT, Claude) to navigate complex software development decisions for an SEO project (Pipulate), leading to clarity on implementing vector embeddings and prioritizing development steps. It emphasizes LLMs as development partners for focus and progress.
sub: Vector embeddings for AI memory systems
